title: 第13章 谁抢先了，这不犯规吗？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“爸爸？？？”

风暴大惊失色。

祖国人什么时候有孩子了，还他妈的这么大了，哪个野女人抢在了我前面？

对，风暴本就打算将来用个孩子彻底绑住阿祖的。

这边风暴满心惊诧与惊疑，那头阿祖却在见到莱恩以后压根就当她不存在了。

“是吵醒你了吗，儿子。”

阿祖的声音温柔极了。

一旁的风暴见到祖国人这个死出，心在滴血。

“等一下爸爸就把不相干的人赶走，你还困吗，要不要回去再睡一会？”

我是不相干的人——风暴？

“不了，今天起来的已经很晚了。”

莱恩怎么可能回去接着睡。

他在听到推门闯进来的是风暴女时就已经将警报拉响。

这个女人可不是个简单角色，在原本的剧情线上祖国人彻底黑化，并且后期会走上独裁统治风暴要承担一大半的责任。

她的死亡方式、她的纳粹思想对其都造成了深远影响。

早在做好打算来祖国人这边前，莱恩就已经罗列出了他的必做事项。

除了借壳生蛋拍摄改编电影获取经验值外，其中之一就是阻止阿祖这个金刚钻与风暴这台绞肉机勾搭到一起去。

这两个人的战斗力太过血腥猎奇了。

莱恩小脑袋瓜里的糟糕画面一闪即逝，某个阿祖在风暴胯下为其…的画面还未播放就被他掐断。

他的注意力也同时落回眼前，并暗自打起全部精神。

他不知道发生了什么事，但莱恩已经确认了一点，那就是此时的阿祖还没有和风暴彻底走到一起。

抬手揉揉眼睛，假意才看清风暴的样子，莱恩招呼一声：“嗨，风暴你好，我看过你的入队介绍。”

“呃…你好！”

风暴也从惊愕震怒中回神，祖国人在场，即便她心里再怎么膈应这个死孩子，她也得表现出热情来。

“哇哦，我刚刚听到了你叫祖国人爸爸，所以你是他的孩子对吗？”

风暴很自来熟似的一点不拿自己当外人：“不是我说…祖国人，你有这么可爱的儿子干嘛要藏起来，我们居然都不知道。”

“顺便说一句，小子，你帅气满分呦。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Dad???"

The storm was shocked.

When did the people of the motherland have children, and they are so fucking old, which wild woman got ahead of me?

Yes, Feng Feng had originally planned to use a child to completely tie up Azu in the future.

The storm here was full of shock and suspicion, but Azu on the other side simply pretended that Lane didn't exist after seeing her.

"Did it wake you up, son?"

Azu's voice was extremely gentle.

Feng Feng on the side felt his heart bleed when he saw the death of his motherland.

"Dad will drive away the irrelevant people in a moment. Are you still sleepy? Do you want to go back and sleep for a while?"

Am I irrelevant - the storm?

"No, I got up very late today."

How could Ryan go back to sleep?

He had already sounded the alarm when he heard that it was Storm Girl who pushed open the door and burst in.

This woman is not a simple character. In the original plot line, the people of the motherland were completely blackened, and she will bear most of the responsibility for the storm of dictatorship in the later period.

The manner of her death and her Nazi ideology had a profound impact on her.

Even before he made plans to come to his native country, Ryan had already listed his must-dos.

In addition to earning experience points by borrowing eggs to make movie adaptations, one of them is to prevent Azu, the diamond, and Storm, the meat grinder, from getting together.

The fighting power of these two people is too bloody and curious.

The bad images flashed through Ryan's little head, and the image of a certain Azu on Storm's crotch was cut off by him before it even played.

His attention also fell back to his eyes at the same time, and he secretly cheered up.

He didn't know what happened, but Ryan had already confirmed one thing, that is, Azu had not completely come together with the storm at this time.

Raising his hand to rub his eyes, he pretended to see Storm clearly. Ryan said hello, "Hi Storm, I've seen your introduction to the team."

"Uh...hello!"

Feng Feng also recovered from the shock and anger. With the presence of her motherland, no matter how much she hated this dead child, she still had to show enthusiasm.

"Wow, I just heard you call Fatherland, so you are his child, right?"

Feng Feng seemed to be familiar with him and didn't regard himself as an outsider at all: "It's not me... People of the motherland, why do you hide such a lovely son? We don't even know about it."

"By the way, boy, you are very handsome."
